## 0.1.0 (2026-10-22)

This is the first stable release of the public npm SDK. All 21 packages use
version `0.1.0` and publish under `latest`.

Wait for the [Release workflow](https://github.com/maelstrom-co/maelstrom/actions/workflows/release.yml)
to finish before installing. Follow the
[tagged setup guide](https://github.com/maelstrom-co/maelstrom/blob/v0.1.0/README.md)
to get started.

### 🚀 Features

- **devtools:** model retained request outcomes and timing
- **devtools:** add the retained request overview
- **devtools:** add composable event filters (MAE-896)
- **protocol:** add agent wire unions and envelope frames

### 🩹 Fixes

- **devtools:** preserve voice request ownership and provenance
